name: After § 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
part_text: 1f. Expresses deep concern at the findings of the 2025 Lancet Global Health study estimating that unilateral sanctions are associated with around 564 000 deaths annually, with children under five representing 51 % of these deaths; calls for an end to the US embargo and sanctions regime in the light of these findings;
